title: Manager 1on1 Feedback 001
targetProfile: Chinese native speaker, N1 reading, weak workplace Japanese. User is manager / executive doing 1on1s with direct reports. This pack covers four feedback modes — concrete praise, soft suggestion, expectation-setting, careful critical feedback. All 丁寧 (manager → report is polite-but-not-formal).
